chunk_findings.detail: `out_of_order` still ranks every name in `CANON` separately, so a later first-run of any lower-rank gate marks this gate early. The file’s own note on `CANON` (and [D-path-merge-answers]) says research+rules+implement and bug_hunt+dedupe are merged lanes, so order is per-lane, not per-gate. Given one item implement@10, research@20, rules@30, `first_at["research"]==20 > 10` and research’s rank is below implement, so implement is appended as out of order even though those three runs are one bookkeeping lane.

chunk_findings.detail: `overlap` sets `sum_p50_s` to `union.p50_s + saved_by_union.p50_s` and `burst_share` to that ratio. Those p50s are medians of different series, so their sum is not the p50 of the per-item sum and the ratio is not union-versus-sum. Two items with (union, saved) = (10, 0) and (1000, 90) can yield union p50 10 and saved p50 90, so this returns burst_share 10% while the item shares are 100% and about 92%.

Given one item implement@10, research@20, rules@30, `first_at["research"]==20 > 10` and research’s rank is below implement, so implement is appended as out of order even though those three runs are one bookkeeping lane.

chunk_findings.detail: `overlap` sets `sum_p50_s` to `union.p50_s + saved_by_union.p50_s` and `burst_share` to that ratio. Those p50s are medians of different series, so their sum is not the p50 of the per-item sum and the ratio is not union-versus-sum. Two items with (union, saved) = (10, 0) and (1000, 90) can yield union p50 10 and saved p50 90, so this returns burst_share 10% while the item shares are 100% and about 92%.
